record.question: Which of the following produces growth hormones?
record.explanation: Answer C: Pituitary gland. Growth hormone is secreted by the anterior pituitary gland. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK279116/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
